prompts.reactions: Use case: stylized-concept. Input image 1 is the identity reference: reproduce this exact cute green jungle dinosaur with dark green leaf crown, gold headband and emerald, leaf shoulder decorations, cream muzzle and belly, gold round chest clock. Fill the clock with a fixed cream dial and dark hands at 8:00 (never a transparent hole). Same polished soft 3D illustration. No red bandana. Each cell one complete full-body dinosaur, consistently sized, feet at 94% of cell height, head crown at 4%, centered with 8% safe padding, no clipping. Keep identical face and wardrobe and proportions across cells. Transparent background, no shadows outside character, no text, no cell lines or labels.
